identity.title: Spatially Resolved Dense Molecular Gas Excitation in the Nearby LIRG VV 114

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present high-resolution observations (0.2$''$–1.5$''$) of multiple dense gas tracers, HCN and HCO$^+$ ($J$ = 1–0, 3–2, and 4–3), HNC ($J$ = 1–0), and CS ($J$ = 7–6) lines

evidence.quote: We have adopted H$_0$ = 70 km s$^{-1}$ Mpc$^{-1}$, $\Omega_{m}$ = 0.3, and $\Omega_{\Lambda}$ = 0.7 throughout this Paper.

question.value: How does dense molecular gas excitation, star formation efficiency and chemistry vary across the AGN, starburst and shocked Overlap regions of the merging LIRG VV 114?

evidence.quote: VV 114 has three distinctive regions that are expected to show different dense gas excitation and/or chemistry, i.e., the X-ray-bright AGN, starburst regions, and the shocked Overlap
ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00467.S, ADS/JAO.ALMA#2013.1.00740.S, ADS/JAO.ALMA#2013.1.01057.S, and ADS/JAO.ALMA#2015.1.00973.S
toward the nearby luminous infrared galaxy VV 114 with ALMA bands 3, 6, and 7
with a projected baseline length ($L_{\rm baseline}$) of 18–780 m (19–650 m)
$L_{\rm baseline}$ of 16.7–641.5 m (MRS $\sim$ 9$''$)

claims.hypothesis: Does dense gas fraction control star formation efficiency (density threshold model)?
claims.experiment: Compare SFE_H2 vs f_dense across 11 apertures
claims.finding: Density threshold model not appropriate for VV 114

evidence.quote: showing that the density threshold model is not appropriate for the VV 114 data

claims.hypothesis: Is the Overlap region more turbulent and diffuse than the nucleus?
claims.result: Overlap M~5, n~10^4.0 vs nucleus M~2, n~10^4.5
claims.finding: Overlap has more turbulent diffuse gas, possibly shock-induced

evidence.quote: The grid clearly characterizes the Overlap region as a turbulent lower density ISM

claims.result: T_rot correlates with Sigma_SFR except Region 1; X_HCN flat at (3.5±0.7)e-9

limitations_admitted.value: Possible synchrotron contamination of 110 GHz SFR (~25%); absolute values uncertain due to conversion factors

evidence.quote: The absolute values are uncertain because of the assumed conversion factors to derive the surface densities and the assigned SFR tracer.
